header: Unsupported Parameters by Proxy Type and TLS Version
content:
Decryption Log fields display decryption session parameters for each decryption proxy type.
However, for reasons such as version support, encrypted portions of TLS handshakes, information
availability, etc., some parameters are not available for every proxy type or TLS version. The
following table shows unsupported Decryption log parameters by proxy type and TLS version.
